theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_efp_inverse_coset_eq_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ), (QuotientGroup.mk (A⁻¹) : (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) = QuotientGroup.mk (B⁻¹) ↔ ∃ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, (B 1 0 : ZMod N) = (u : ZMod N) * (A 1 0 : ZMod N) ∧ (B 1 1 : ZMod N) = (u : ZMod N) * (A 1 1 : ZMod N)
